_about: Every figure here is copied from docs/testing-1.4.2.md (and docs/evaluation.md for sets 30 and 42). Edit a value there first, then here, then run make_charts.py with an absolute --out.

ladder.method: Good = 7 or more out of 10 from blind AI graders, two rounds. 160 new questions in four sealed sets, every model.

collections.sourceLine: Sets 30 and 42 and 149 sealed fact questions, graded blind. Details in docs/evaluation.md and docs/testing-1.4.2.md.

storage.sourceLine: Measured 21 October 2026: app 173 MB, data 47.40 GB. Details in docs/evaluation.md.
notes: The Encyclopedia alone holds 8.39 million searchable passages of Wikipedia.
51 first-aid guides, each with a recorded reading, and the emergency numbers of 242 countries are built into the app.
